root: ^Would you do me a small favor, you and these others?
^Well, here you all are, and good friends of dear Patrick’s too,
^and helping to catch the man who killed him.
^You must be terribly hungry by now because it’s long past your suppertime,
^and I know Patrick would never forgive me, God bless his soul,
^if I allowed you to remain in his house without offering you decent hospitality.
^Why don’t you eat up that lamb that’s in the oven.
^It’ll be cooked just right by now.

c-0: ^Personally I couldn’t touch a thing, certainly not what’s been in the house when he was here.
^But it’s all right for you. It’d be a favor to me if you’d eat it up.
^Then you can go on with your work again afterwards.
^Police: If you so insist Mrs. Maloney.
^We'll help ourselves then. I appreciate your consideration.
c-1: ^Police: May I ask why, Mrs. Maloney?
^Well, um, I don't think I could touch a thing, certainly not what's been in the house when he was here.
^And seeing as you gentlemen have no interest in it, I don't know what I might do with it.
^Forget about it. Continue on with your investigation then.
